_: THE DAYS — every dated task between the reset and Opening Day, Mike's and Ops'. Each carries the literal instruction for the moment it is done. `check` lets the desk read done from the tree; TASKS.db.json (synced from the served page's store) carries what Mike ticked; `done: true` here is Ops' hand. Edited by Ops; rendered by tools/days.mjs into docs/desk/DAYS.html.

tasks.title: Element takes 1: the Everyday
do: The Everyday, plate on. Gloves, white coat. iPhone on the tripod, 4K, landscape, 30 fps. No microphone: the sound is laid in afterwards from the machine's own recordings; the phone's mic is enough as a reference.
Take 1: sixty seconds scrolling the knob and clicking the igniter, the glass in frame.
Take 2: sixty seconds turning the unit from the top to the back to the front.
Take 3: sixty seconds handheld, you moving around the device.
Take 4: the glass plate. Static, close, square on, sharp, the display lit, ten seconds. This is what the twin's answer gets composited into.
Slate each take: an index card held in front of the lens for two seconds at the start, written on it EVERYDAY · 09-15 · take N · the room. So every file says what it is in its own first frame.
Drop them in OneDrive › WeirdBaby › reels › intake › practice as practice-2026-09-15-1.mp4 to -4.mp4, plus one line of notes: room, light, time, distance, the annoyance.
Back to you by Friday: a cut from the takes and the first composite on the glass plate.
09-16: not landed. What arrived instead is the Gambler tray set and a 4K turn of the Everyday on white (docs/desk/GAMBLER-SET.html). The row stays open until the four takes exist.
tasks.long: The first element takes on the Everyday (ruled 09-12): knob, turn, handheld, plus the static glass plate

tasks.title: Practice reel 4 of 9
do: Shoot ONE clip, vertical, raw, under 30 seconds: any question, the machine answering. You silent. The Audigo on, so the machine's own sounds carry. Phone on the tripod in the room you mean to use.
The beat: shake or click, the answer on the glass, hold two seconds. Nothing else. The question is burned in as text by the reel line (ruled 09-12); do not show it on camera.
Drop it in OneDrive › WeirdBaby › reels › intake › practice as practice-2026-09-22.mp4 (mov is fine).
With it, one line of notes in chat or a text file beside it: room, light, time of day, distance from the lens, and the thing that annoyed you most.

Success = the file lands, the glass reads at phone size, the machine is heard, the beat is there, the notes line exists, and it comes back to you the same day built with the pop and a three-line read.
Practice 4 of 9. Not posted, not final, not a real question.
